Meet Kimo

Kimo cooks the island food he grew up on

Kimo grew up in San Roque, Saipan, at his grandma's house. Family gatherings meant picnic tables covered in paper plates of sashimi and island snacks.

Before the truck, Kimo sold small island plates from home on Fridays and Saturdays while working full time.

“I'm no Chef, all my recipes come from recreating the food I love & experienced, plus those closest to me know that I'm an incredible host!”— Kimo, on Instagram

Back home, those small plates get shared with friends and family: at the picnic table, at the beach, over a game of cards. That's Orionz, right here in Salem.

What people love

Island style, baby. Pull up to the picnic table and say hi.
